summary: Proud Tek serves European hotel chains, event organizers, laundry services, and system integrators with RoHS and REACH-compliant RFID products. From Scandinavian hotel chains to Mediterranean resort groups, we provide custom manufacturing with EU-ready documentation.
heroPoints: RoHS, REACH, and CE documentation provided for all product families — ready for EU import compliance.
Express air freight to major European cities in 5-7 working days; sea freight 18-22 days.
Compatible with European lock systems: ASSA ABLOY, Salto, Hafele, Dialock, VingCard.

sections.title: Why European buyers source from Proud Tek
bullets: Compliance documentation — we provide RoHS, REACH, and CE marking certificates for all product families, simplifying EU import declarations.
Lock system compatibility — our hotel key cards are tested against ASSA ABLOY Visionline, Salto, VingCard, Hafele, and Dialock systems used across European hotel chains.
GDPR-aware encoding — we support data encoding workflows that align with European data handling requirements, including guest data minimization on card chips.
Sustainability options — recycled PVC cards, biodegradable wristbands, and eco-friendly packaging available for properties with green certification goals.

faq.question: Do your products meet EU RoHS and REACH requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. All our RFID cards, tags, and wristbands are manufactured with RoHS and REACH-compliant materials. We provide compliance certificates with every order for EU customs clearance.

faq.question: How long does shipping to Europe take?
faq.answer: Express air freight (DHL/FedEx) delivers to major EU cities in 5-7 working days. Sea freight takes 18-22 days to ports like Rotterdam, Hamburg, or Barcelona.

faq.question: Do you support DESFire EV3 cards for high-security European hotel groups?
faq.answer: Yes. We manufacture MIFARE DESFire EV2 and EV3 cards with AES-128 encryption, pre-personalization services, and encoding support for ASSA ABLOY and Salto platforms.
